record.body:
## Description

AGENTS.md and README.md still describe skills, the dashboard, and scripts as living in this repo. The review marked that judgment. The human answered: update the docs in this phase. CLAUDE.md repeats the same paths.

## Approach

Work on `/home/andrewyin/affidavit--orchestration-split`, branch `phase/orchestration-split`.

Add a failing test in `tests/test_evidence_layout.py`. It reads `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, and `CLAUDE.md` and fails while those files tell a reader to install `skills/init`, `dashboard/bin`, or `skills/kinds-and-focus.md` from this tree, or while they never name `orchestra`. Commit that red.

Rewrite the three files so this repo is the evidence layer: `bin/aff` keeps `check`, `close-batch`, and `verdict`, and the affidavit package stays here. Skills, the dashboard, scripts, and `agents/` live in `~/orchestra`. Do not restore deleted directories. Do not edit `.artifacts`. Do not copy the store onto this branch.

Commit the docs on the phase branch, excluding `.artifacts`. Each commit subject is Conventional Commits, `type(scope): summary`, with a one- or two-sentence why body that names `fix-agent-docs`.

payload.title: Describe affidavit as the evidence layer

record.subject: fix-agent-docs
